suite: Warm async method scheduling allocation callstacks
measurement: One main-thread scheduling marker per case after two completed warmup batches. Each marker contains 128 native, completed-async, or suspended-async calls; full GC precedes the marker. All native and suspended outer awaiters are checked pending after the marker before a frame yield. Callback completion, frame wait, and result consumption occur outside the marker.
reconciliation: All ten case callstack sums equal their corresponding Profiler GC.Alloc marker byte totals. Warm native NextFrame is 0 B/op for both; completed async methods are 64 B/op untyped and 72 B/op typed for both; suspended Onity is 304/312 B/op versus UniTask 64/72 B/op, matching the prior eight-sample report.
interpretationLimit: Method names are resolved allocation stack sites, not confirmed object types. This single diagnostic sample covers synchronous Editor/Mono scheduling only; it does not establish full async lifecycle or Player IL2CPP costs.
